mapper.select: select account_id, create_time, fund_amount, is_delete from fund where account_id=#{accountId} and is_delete=false
mapper.update: update fund set is_delete=true where account_id=#{accountId} and is_delete=false
update fund set fund_amount=fund_amount-#{cost} where account_id=#{accountId} and fund_amount>#{cost} and is_delete=false
update fund set fund_amount=fund_amount+#{rechargeAmount} where account_id=#{accountId} and is_delete=false
